title: Family on Front Porch Steps with Small Dog, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful 1950s black-and-white snapshot depicting three generations outside a white clapboard home. An older man with a cigarette in his mouth holds a toddler perched on his shoulder, standing beside a smiling young woman dressed in mid-century attire featuring a patterned full skirt and bobby socks. At the base of the concrete steps on the lawn, a small terrier-type dog looks up attentively at the family, framing an intimate slice of post-war American domestic life.
